Dairy Owner Redesign v2.6.0
• Redesigned dashboard with clean card layout
• Supplier profile with Paid/Unpaid status in monthly table
• Improved profit calculation (only counts sold milk)
• Stock tracking (purchased minus sold)
• Outstanding balance tracking
• Removed inventory and payment standalone pages
• Cleaner navigation with card-based quick actions
• UI/UX improvements throughout
